sentences.text: The animal possessed a short, deep skull that was extremely gracile.
The upper and lower jaws held between 17 and 23 teeth in total.
These teeth were compact, spoon-shaped, and striated.
It had a long, strong neck with forelimbs shorter than its hind legs.
The fifth toe was reduced, while the claw of the first toe remained robust.
Paul estimated the animal's length at 9 meters and its weight at 2 tonnes.
The discovery consisted of 3 tonnes of material prepared by the regional culture academy.
The fossils were found in August 1987 by Mr. Xingyong Zhang.
The specimens were found in the Fengjiahe Formation in Yunnan Province, China.
The holotype, YXV 8701, consists of a complete skull and mandible lacking only the anterior jaw end and minor orbital bone fragments.
Yimenosaurus is classified as a member of the Sauropodomorpha order within the Plateosauridae family.
This classification was made in 1990 but without an exact cladistic analysis.
It lived at the beginning of the Jurassic Period, approximately 195 to 190 million years ago.
The fossil record indicates a time range from 201.4 to 199.5 million years ago during the Hettangian stage.
Recently, its classification has been questioned due to the particular nature of its skull.
